source_title: Patrick Mahomes’ latest move with Brittany reveals another side of his Kansas City life - The Times of India
source_excerpt: Patrick Mahomesâ influence in Kansas City reaches well beyond the football field. The Kansas City Chiefs quarterback and his wife, Brittany Mahomes, have launched a new initiative aimed at helping families manage food allergies when dining out. Their project, called 15 and Fare, brings Mahomesâ charitable foundation together with Food Allergy Research & Education (FARE) to encourage safer food preparation at local restaurants. The effort also has a personal connection for the couple, whose two eldest children have food allergies. It offers a closer look at how their family experiences are shaping their work in the community.Patrick Mahomes and Brittany launch 15 and FARE to improve restaurant food safetyThe initiative has reached an important milestone with Joeâs Kansas City Bar-B-Que becoming its first recognized restaurant partner. The restaurant announced the achievement on October 27, highlighting its efforts to train staff in food allergy preparation and handling.The recognition is based on practical steps rather than a simple endorsement. Participating restaurants must train at least 90% of their food service staff, complete monthly on-site audits for three consecutive months, establish a written food allergy management policy and provide clear allergen information on their menus.These requirements address a concern that many diners face every time they eat outside their homes. For families managing food allergies, ordering a meal can involve detailed questions about ingredients, preparation methods and the risk of cross-contact. A restaurant's willingness to answer those questions matters, but consistent procedures can make the experience safer and less stressful.Joeâs Kansas City Bar-B-Que acknowledged the significance of its recognition in an announcement shared online."We are really proud today to post this sign up. Joe's is the first restaurant to be recognized as 15 & Fare approved. Over the past two years our managment staff in our restaurants have become certified in food allergy prep & handling."This initiative was started by @patrickmahomes & @brittanylynne and their charity @15andMahomies. Now we want others to join us! We'll be sharing soon how other restaurants can join 15 & Fare!"The restaurant's recognition gives the program a tangible starting point. The next challenge is to persuade more local businesses to adopt the same standards and make allergy awareness part of their daily operations.Their children's food allergies give the initiative a personal purposeFor Patrick and Brittany, the project is rooted in their own family experiences. Their two eldest children, Sterling and Bronze, have food allergies, giving the couple a personal understanding of the concerns parents face when they cannot be certain how a meal has been prepared.That connection helps explain why the initiative goes beyond restaurant recognition. Through a partnership between the 15 and the Mahomies Foundation and Food Allergy Research & Education, known as FARE, the program also aims to expand access to education, support and resources across Kansas City. Training opportunities extend to community food banks and pantries, where food safety can be just as important.The work also adds another dimension to Mahomes' public role. His achievements with the Chiefs have made him one of the NFL's most recognizable players, but this effort focuses on a problem that families deal with far from the stadium. Brittany's involvement reflects that same personal commitment, turning an experience within their household into a community effort.The couple cannot remove the risks associated with food allergies, and a restaurant's approval should not replace a diner's own precautions. Still, better training, clearer menus and stronger preparation practices can help families make informed choices.For Kansas City, the real measure of success will be whether more restaurants follow Joe's example. One recognized business is an encouraging start.
